MORE:
Dear Sir/Madam,
This is to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held today i.e. 2nd November, 2026 at the registered office of the company situated at Dinalipi Bhawan, A-54/1 & A-55/1, Nayapalli, Baramunda, BBSR, Odisha - 751003. The Board considered and approved the following:
1. Took on record Quarterly Compliance done under SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
2. Considered Quarterly Unaudited Financial Results along with the Limited Review Report thereon for the Quarter and Half Year ended on 30th September, 2026.
3. Took note of the resignation of Mrs. Manisha Satapathy from the position of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer with effect from the close of business hours on 02.11.2026.
4. Approved the appointment of Mr. Soumya Ranjan Behera (ACS-A78725) as the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company with effect from 02.11.2026.
This information is for your kind perusal and record.

The Board Meeting to be held on 02/11/2026 has been revised to 02/11/2026 In continuation to our earlier intimation dated 26th October 2026 regarding the Board Meeting schedule, this is to inform you that the time of the Board Meeting scheduled to be held on Monday, 02nd November 2026 has been revised.
The meeting, which was earlier scheduled to be held at 12:00 P.M., will now be held at 03:00 P.M. at the registered office of the Company at Dinalipi Bhawan, A-54/1 & A-55/1, Nayapalli, Baramunda, Bhubaneswar, Odisha-751003, to consider and approve the Un-audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September, 2026 and other agenda items.
This is for your information and record.
